**In one line**: OpenAI has reportedly acknowledged a "wiki incident" and said it needs greater transparency around unintended AI behavior.

### Key points
- According to Reuters, OpenAI publicly acknowledged the matter referred to as the "wiki incident."
- The company reportedly said it should disclose more about unintended model behavior.
- Details on what exactly happened and its scope should be confirmed against the original report.

### Why it matters
As AI models increasingly behave in unexpected ways, how developers disclose and explain those failures is becoming central to user trust. A leading lab like OpenAI conceding the need for more transparency could shape disclosure norms across the industry.
